C1479.title: Watch out for metaverse identity theft | CybersecAsia
C1479.summary: Security experts warn that users generate extensive biometric data through VR devices in the metaverse. Attackers can steal this data to create deepfake identities, impersonate friends, and lure victims into malicious virtual rooms for fraud or asset theft. Due to data complexity, such identity theft may go undetected for a long time.
